name: graph-visible-tests-config-premise
body: `apg/config.json` carries a `test` rule in its `types` list covering the relocated layout, so a scan of this repo classifies the relocated tests as `test`; a present config replaces the built-in per-language defaults (`src/classify.rs::classify_code_type` iterates `cfg.types` then returns `cfg.default`). The bundled structural scanner graphs tracked config/manifest artifacts, so `apg/config.json` is a `File` node with `code_type = 'config'` (likewise `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `rust-toolchain.toml`, `scripts/gate.sh`).
